Game day, any team · IDEA 04

Courtside Canopy

CONCEPT ONLY · NO PRINT FILES

A simple sports-court platform under a curved grandstand visor, with two lift-out seed cups. Any color pairing; no team crests or league branding.

This is an unbuilt design study. No CAD, STL, STEP, 3MF, print time, filament weight, price or physical test result is available. It is not ready to print, order or reserve.

Compare all four concepts

Shortlists stay in this browser. Nothing is submitted and no vote count is claimed.

How this could work

Design intent, not a claim that these mechanisms have been engineered or tested.

Different on purpose

Wide open court and a single rear visor, not another enclosed football or helmet.

Feeding system

Two shallow removable cups allow a small daily portion. Court lines stay outside the seed wells and do not create cleaning grooves inside them.

Refill & cleaning

Lift each cup straight out. The visor should detach independently for cleaning without disturbing the installed backplate.

Mounting approach

Proposed wall/post mounting rather than an overhead hanger. Load direction and attachment spacing need engineering.

Proposed print breakdown

Target: platform/backplate, visor and two identical cups. Cost, plate count and strength are untested.

Tests before this becomes a product

  1. Cup retention against tipping and wind uplift
  2. Drainage beneath both cups
  3. Sight lines, access and cleaning with the visor installed

Before any download release: finish measured CAD, verify every connected solid and drain, arrange the real parts on plates, run a native slicer roundtrip, then perform fit, cleaning, seed-flow and load trials.

Why explore this direction?

Exploratory hypothesis; no suitable category-level feeder demand evidence verified.

Our theme-to-feeder interpretation is a hypothesis. A familiar aesthetic does not establish purchase intent, and the illustration is not a customer review or licensed collaboration.

Original geometry and naming should remain independent of protected characters, logos, book covers and recognizable franchise props.
